name: vault
description: Field-level envelope encryption (per-subject DEKs, AAD-bound ciphertexts, blind indexes, crypto-shredding) with an env-key or secretr-backed KMS (vault.backend in config/app.bcl), plus an encrypted-blob object store.
env: # vault module: 32 random bytes, base64url (openssl rand -base64 32 | tr '+/' '-_' | tr -d '=\n'). Empty is allowed only in development (ciphertexts then do not survive a restart).
